card.name: Society or Association in organization names
card.fires_on: The word Association, Society, or a part of it (Gesellschaft, Confederación) that ends the first part of a professional or scholarly organization name. It appears in citations, journal credits and acknowledgments, often just before "for" or "of".

modes.label: Association/Society
modes.description: The head noun of an English-language organization name, just before for or of.
modes.example: Copyright 2009 by the Australasian<< Society>> for Cognitive Science.

modes.label: Foreign or split forms
modes.description: Part of a foreign-language or split organization word such as Gesellschaft or Confederación.
